purpose: D2 — smaller-scale replication of the overflow-scenario finding, to confirm the admission-release-vs-physical-completion gap is a reproducible pattern rather than a one-off at 60 chunks.
finding: Same pattern as the overflow-scenario at smaller scale: terminal outcome=completed fired 25ms after request start, while the client took 3.18s to actually finish receiving the data — confirming the admission-release-vs-physical-delivery gap is reproducible, not a fluke of the larger 60-chunk run.
interpretation_constraints: Not a bug. Not a performance claim. See p3c/overflow-scenario/result-summary.json for the full interpretation constraints — identical here.
